# Madison Hope Steiner | Principal AI Architect

Madison Hope Steiner is a Principal AI Architect whose public engineering identities are mh0pe and awsmadi. This site is Madison Hope Steiner's source-linked open-source systems portfolio.

## Canonical portfolio

- Portfolio: https://mh0pe.github.io/
- Madison Hope Steiner on GitHub (mh0pe): https://github.com/mh0pe
- Madison Hope Steiner on GitHub (awsmadi): https://github.com/awsmadi
- Madison Hope Steiner on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/madisonhsteiner

## Public work represented

The portfolio covers workspace-scale security orchestration, reproducible scanner execution, agent teams, durable decision memory, organizational learning systems, cloud architecture, Nix runtime work on Windows, browser runtimes, and developer tooling. Each project links to public repositories, pull requests, commits, files, reviews, and documentation where available.

## Evidence policy

The portfolio uses public GitHub activity from mh0pe and awsmadi. It distinguishes upstream merges, active reviews, and capabilities available from public branches. Employment history follows the linked public LinkedIn profile. The site is personal and does not speak for any employer.
